verdict.rationale: Clerk documents first-party machine authentication. M2M tokens 'authenticate calls between your agents', with a dedicated machine-auth/m2m-tokens guide, and API keys authenticate scripts, cron jobs and partner backends without a user session. The pricing page confirms 'Machine Authentication — API Keys & M2M Tokens' as a metered feature across plans. missing for 10: explicit evidence that M2M issuance follows a standard OAuth client-credentials grant, detail on how machine credentials are issued, scoped and verified, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
